title: Bantan Sango Case File: Cleanup Work
description: Ryuuji from the Bantan Sango Detective Agency seems to want to do something...

mainQuestExcel.title: Bantan Sango Case File: Cleanup Work
mainQuestExcel.description: Ryuuji from the Bantan Sango Detective Agency seems to want to do something...

dialogs.text: Huh. What are the odds, Traveler? Sango was right about us meeting again.
What brings you here?
Sango asked me to finish up the last job.
Which just involves bringing some dessert to the Doushin to thank them for their assistance.
They should be thanking us.
That's true. Well, it's just an excuse to improve our relationship with them.
After all, our detective agency may need their help someday.
It sounds just like Sango...
Haha, yes. Your intuition is as sharp as ever.
So what do you think of all this, personally?
Me? Amano and Andou... We used to be colleagues, so it's normal to show a bit of kindness with some dessert.
But... Sango also asked me to investigate another matter today, so the timing is a bit tight...
Traveler, could you please help me deliver these desserts to three people?
No problem.
Thanks for your help.
Here are three packs of desserts for Amano, Andou, and Mr. Owada.
Mr. Owada?
He is also my... former colleague. He was good to me before I left the police force.
He also helped us deal with the police on the serial burglary case previously.
I'll leave it to you then, Traveler. After you finish delivering the dessert, we'll meet back here.
I think it would be better for you to deliver them.
But... Sango's request is more important...
I'll find time to visit the three of them later.
Sango must have taught you this.
Wasn't it us who helped them?
Oh, it's you, Traveler. What are you doing here?
This is for you from Ryuuji.
Oh? Let's see... Wow, Sakura Mochi... Ah, that lad Ryuuji, he really didn't have to...
#Hey, Andou. Stop being so cautious. The Traveler may be an outlander, but {F#she}{M#he} just helped us, didn't {F#she}{M#he}?
I'm surprised Ryuuji still remembers what we like. Being colleagues with him sure has its perks...
You guys worked together with Ryuuji?
Hmm? He didn't mention it to you? We worked with him for a short time.
But he suddenly got wrapped up in a certain incident.
Thanks to Sango, the real culprit was caught and Ryuuji was exonerated. Later, he left the police station and went to work for Sango.
That's all I know...
Okay. That's probably enough about that.
True. Anyway, he's been having it a lot easier with Sango than with us.
If I could, I'd also like to...
Hey, come on...
Ahem! By the way, thank you, Traveler. I'll take these desserts.
Say hello to Ryuuji and Sango for me.
Hmm? You're... the Traveler, right? I heard Amano mention you.
Is there something you'd like to see me about?
This is from Ryuuji.
Wow, it's Sakura Mochi... Well then, I can't simply eat it casually. I'll have to find a nice place to enjoy it.
Uesugi, please cover for me a bit. If someone comes to see me, tell them to wait a moment.
But it's work hours, Mr. Owada...
Hahaha, it's okay. I'm just going out for some air. I'll be back soon.
*sigh*... Okay, but please come back soon. If any of the higher-ups come by...
Don't worry, we just solved a case, so if someone comes, they'll be here to praise us.
I'll leave it to you then, Uesugi.
Traveler, walk with me for a while. I know a perfect place for enjoying these Sakura Mochi.
Ah... this place is nice, isn't it? I often come here...
The view is nice and the air is fresh.
If you have anything to ask me, now's the time.
Are you Ryuuji's former colleague too?
Did Ryuuji tell you that? Yes, Ryuuji and I did work together once.
I don't know if Ryuuji has mentioned what happened back then.
Simply put, Ryuuji was too impulsive. He wound up walking into a trap and becoming a scapegoat.
I vouched for him, but the judge still insisted on convicting him.
I asked many people to help investigate, but they either came back empty-handed or told me not to continue the investigation.
Heh. At that time, I... How should I put it... I heeded the warning and didn't investigate further.
It is a "secret" that everyone knows, just like the fact that Ryuuji was wrongly accused, so I don't mind telling you.
But since everyone knows...
Ah, it's precisely because everyone knows that no one dares to interfere.
Fortunately, a detective who was out of the loop happened to come to the police station for business and became interested in the case.
Thanks to that detective, the case was finally solved and Ryuuji's name was cleared.
Ryuuji left the police station and worked for that detective from then on. That's the whole story.
Why are you telling me this?
Who asked you to give me this gift?
Ryuuji.
I'm sure this gift was Sango's doing.
Given Ryuuji's character, if Sango had asked him to deliver the gift personally, he would have delivered it to me in mint condition even if I was trapped in a sea of fire.
But Ryuuji asked you to deliver the gift to me, which means that Sango asked him to have you do it.
So Sango wanted me to know, then?
Hahaha, you're no slowcoach either. Your presence here means that Sango is telling me, "I have a new helper."
It seems that she isn't over what happened back then.
Actually, that's not surprising. After all... she hasn't found the real person who laid that trap yet...
Well, I've told you everything I can. You can decide for yourself whether you want to join Sango or not.
Oh, and thank Ryuuji for the Sakura Mochi for me. I've always enjoyed them.
Why did Ryuuji leave the police?
It was his own choice to leave.
Sorry for troubling you, Traveler. Did you give the gifts to all of them?
Did Sango arrange all this?
You found out? Sorry... It was Sango's idea to get you to deliver those.
Sango said that you will be indispensable in helping solve that case and uncovering the real culprit.
Is the case still not completely solved?
Not yet. Sango said everything had pointed perfectly to the "culprit" back then. Too perfectly, in fact.
When Sango started her investigation, all the clues, motives, and evidence fell right into her hands and pointed to that "culprit."
That person was held as the culprit by the police in the end, but Sango believed that the real culprit was someone else.
I think the reason why she took me into her office was for the chance to solve that case.
But what can I do to help...
Sango's mind... I can't read it. But she mentioned to me that she might be getting tunnel vision from being in Inazuma for so long...
If we had someone knowledgeable with a fresh set of eyes to help, perhaps there could be a breakthrough.
Traveler, Sango may believe you are the one who can help her.
So I guess I'm a detective as well now?
If you're willing to help us, then of course you are.
You have helped our agency so much, so please, accept the payment upfront this time.
Did Sango tell you to say all this too?
No, these are all my own words.
Thank you again for your assistance. Feel free to come around more often. I'm sure Sango will welcome your presence as well.
I suppose this case pays a lot?
I couldn't give you a number, but the pay will be good enough, I'm sure.
Is this case the perfect crime Sango was talking about?
Indeed. Sango once told me that everything had pointed perfectly to the "culprit" back then. Too perfectly, in fact.
When Sango started her investigation, all the clues, motives, and evidence fell right into her hands and pointed to that "culprit."
That person was held as the culprit by the police in the end, but Sango believed that the real culprit was someone else.
You could have just told me what happened...
I'll leave it to you then, Traveler. After you finish delivering the dessert, we'll meet back here.
